outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Club Atlético de Madrid 1.46 vs FC Barcelona 1.93, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.

FC Barcelona away: 5W-0D-0L, 22 scored and 5 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.69 goals per game, away teams 1.29.
Recent league form (newest first): Club Atlético de Madrid WWWWW, FC Barcelona WLWWW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.

Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
